_about: English interface text. Keys are the Simplified Chinese source strings; an empty value means 'not translated yet' and the source text is shown. 'strings' are exact matches (tr() literals, trf() templates with {name} fields, constant exception messages). 'templates' match already formatted runtime messages: each {name} matches any text and the captured piece is looked up once more. Keep every {name} (and format spec) of the key in the English value. Maintained by tests/test_i18n.py (coverage tests).

strings.MoonLabeler {version}\n\n作者：Fluorine Zhu:
MoonLabeler {version}

Author: Fluorine Zhu
Licence: GNU GPL v3.0 or later

In tribute to the Lunar Terminator Visualization Tool created by Jim Mosher and Henrik Bondo. MoonLabeler follows its approach to feature-point calibration and DEM lighting, implemented independently in Python / Qt.

Thanks to 樊仕达 (Fan Shida, 10deg) for the moonlib code reference and the LPND Chinese feature-name data.

Thanks to 蔡明翰 ({evan_tsai}) for Traditional Chinese support and fixes for several Windows issues.

Thanks to {sothic} for the toolbar zoom controls, actual-size view and keyboard shortcuts.

Feature names: USGS / IAU; Chinese names prefer LPND, with supplementary sources recorded separately.
Lunar elevation: LRO / LOLA; ephemeris: JPL DE421; landing sites: NASA NSSDCA / LROC.
Crater candidate detection is adapted from Ram Maruboina's Lunar Crater Detector (MIT).
See ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md and README.md in the project folder for sources and model limitations.

strings.自动：打开照片，设置拍摄日期，点击“自动识别并标注”。时间默认 UTC 15:0:
Automatic: open a photo, set the capture date and click "Identify and annotate". The time defaults to 15:00 UTC and can be changed by expanding the time section; convert local time to UTC. Reference data is downloaded on first use.

Assisted crater finding: if automatic recognition fails, detect centres first, select a candidate, search for and click the crater name, then confirm it as a reference point at the bottom. Press Enter to choose the first name.

Reference-assisted automatic registration: after confirming one or two known points, click "Register automatically using reference points" or "Identify and annotate" at the top. MoonLabeler searches nearby features and generates annotations once validation passes.

Manual points: expand "Add points manually", search for a feature name, click the pick button, then click the centre of the same crater's full rim in the photo. Do not click the centre of a bright spot or shadow. Pick 3–6 well-separated, non-collinear points, then complete the calibration.
Esc cancels picking; double-click a reference-point row to re-pick it, or uncheck it to disable it. Orange rows need checking.

Rilles, mountain ranges and other features are selected under "Add points manually".

Annotation: after changing settings, click "Regenerate annotations". {hint} to reposition them; double-click to edit text. Dragging without a modifier key only pans the view. Font sizes are based on the photo's shorter side and split into large, medium and small tiers by apparent diameter; set Font decrement to 0 for a uniform font size. You can save the project or export PNG / SVG.

DEM: import or download elevation data, then select a region to generate a lighting reference. Basic sampling is about 1.9 km; not suitable for regions near the limb.

Rim circles are catalogue projection references and may deviate from the actual crater rims. The fit residual only indicates consistency; see the README for models and data sources.

strings.高程参考只有宽泛明暗，没有足够地形细节。: The elevation reference shows only broad shading, without enough terrain detail.
strings.图像对应点与高程阴影纹理不一致，未采用结果。: The image correspondences disagree with the elevation shadow texture; result not used.
strings.高程阴影参考也未找到通过纹理与分布验证的月面区域。: The elevation shadow reference also found no lunar region that passed texture and distribution validation.
strings.出现多个接近的高程纹理匹配，未采用结果。: Several close elevation-texture matches were found; result not used.
strings.设置保存在本机，下次计算生效。GPU 不可用时自动改用 CPU。: Settings are saved on this computer and apply to the next computation. The CPU is used automatically when no GPU is available.
strings.当前由 MOONLABELER_COMPUTE 环境变量指定，界面设置暂不生效。: Currently set by the MOONLABELER_COMPUTE environment variable; the setting here has no effect.
strings.切换后需重新启动 MoonLabeler 才会生效。设置保存在本机，不写入工程文: Changes take effect after restarting MoonLabeler. The setting is saved on this computer, not in project files.
strings.日期无效，请检查年月日: Invalid date; check the year, month and day
strings.请完整填写有效的日期和 UTC 时分: Enter a complete, valid date and UTC hour and minute
strings.自动：必要时尝试畸变校正；相机直拍：跳过目镜畸变校正；目镜后：允许校正，仍先尝试:
Auto: tries distortion correction when needed; Direct camera: skips eyepiece distortion correction; Afocal: allows correction but still tries ordinary registration first.
After switching, click "Identify and annotate" to apply. Reference-point registration and manual calibration are not affected by this option.
strings.默认 UTC 15:00；展开“具体时间”可修改。修改日期或收起设置不会重置已选: Defaults to 15:00 UTC; expand "Exact time" to change it. Changing the date or collapsing the settings does not reset the chosen time.
strings.输入 UTC 时:分；秒保留默认或工程原值。北京时间需减 8 小时，注意日期跨天: Enter UTC hours:minutes; seconds keep the default or the project's saved value. Convert local time to UTC (e.g. UTC+8 local time minus 8 hours) and watch for date changes.
strings.按上方拍摄日期识别。首次需下载星历和高程数据，之后可离线使用。: Recognizes using the capture date above. Ephemeris and elevation data are downloaded on first use; after that it works offline.
strings.自动配准 · NASA 同时刻影像: Auto-register · NASA image at the same time
strings.NASA 参考支持 2026 年，需联网。: The NASA reference supports 2026 and requires an internet connection.
strings.使用地心视角。高倍局部照片可能因参考细节不足而无法匹配。: Uses a geocentric view. High-magnification close-ups may fail to match because the reference lacks detail.
strings.没有合适候选时，选择地名后在照片中取点。: If no candidate fits, select a feature name and pick the point in the photo.
strings.点击按钮，再到照片中点所选坑的完整坑缘中心。不要点亮斑或阴影中心；可先放大照片。: Click the button, then click the centre of the selected crater's full rim in the photo. Do not click the centre of a bright spot or shadow; zoom in first if needed. Picking the same name again updates its position.
strings.编号对应照片上的十字；双击重选，取消勾选停用。拟合偏差只表示参考点的一致性。: Numbers match the crosses on the photo; double-click to re-pick, uncheck to disable. The fit residual only indicates the consistency of the reference points.
strings.确认一两个已知点后，自动搜索附近地形；周围图像仍需通过验证。: After you confirm one or two known points, nearby features are searched automatically; the surrounding image must still pass validation.
strings.双击重选 · 取消勾选停用: Double-click to re-pick · Uncheck to disable
strings.自动判断镜像（至少三点）: Detect mirroring automatically (at least three points)
strings.校准时会自动计算，通常无需单独操作。: Computed automatically during calibration; usually no separate action is needed.
strings.下载基础 LOLA DEM · 约 33 MB: Download basic LOLA DEM · about 33 MB
strings.渲染参数 · 图像尺寸 / 光照 / 投影: Rendering parameters · Image size / lighting / projection
strings.基础采样约 1.9 km，近月缘区域不适用。: Basic sampling is about 1.9 km; not suitable for regions near the limb.
strings.球面投影与坡度光照参考。增加输出尺寸不会增加地形细节；高倍照片需更高分辨率 DE: Spherical projection and slope-lighting reference. Increasing the output size does not add terrain detail; high-magnification photos need a higher-resolution DEM.
strings.检查照片上的坑体与坑缘明暗，保留亮坑缘、暗坑底；避免日期计算误删可见地形。: Checks the brightness of craters and rims in the photo, keeping bright rims and dark floors, so that the date-based calculation does not remove visible features by mistake.
strings.按公开坐标标注，使用小档字号。勾选后点击重新生成标注。: Annotated at published coordinates using the small font tier. After checking, click Regenerate annotations.
strings.最大字号按照片短边计算；递减为 0 时所有目标使用此字号。调整后点击重新生成标注: The maximum font size is relative to the photo's shorter side; with a decrement of 0, all targets use this size. Click Regenerate annotations after adjusting.
Reduction per tier as a share of the shorter side (percentage points): 1.80% minus 0.30% gives 1.50% and 1.20%.
Tiers by projected apparent diameter: ≥2% of the shorter side is large, 0.8%–2% is medium, <0.8% is small.
Set to 0 for a uniform font size; minimum 6 original-image pixels. Click Regenerate annotations after adjusting.
strings.标注文字的粗细。粗体在手机屏幕和深色描边下更清晰；调整后点击重新生成标注。: Weight of the label text. Bold stays legible on phone screens and under the dark halo. Click Regenerate annotations after adjusting.
strings.重要地形先排，普通标注让位；避让标签、中心和引线。保留手动拖动的位置。: Important features are placed first and ordinary labels give way; avoids overlapping labels, centres and leader lines. Manually dragged positions are kept.
strings.大坑显示坑缘圈: Show rim circles for large craters
strings.直径至少 35 km 且在照片中足够大的环形山显示轮廓，小坑保留短引线。: Craters at least 35 km in diameter that are large enough in the photo show an outline; small craters keep short leader lines.
strings.中文译名未收录时显示官方原名。繁体选项由简体译名经 OpenCC 转换。: When no Chinese name is available, the official name is shown. Traditional options are converted from the Simplified names with OpenCC.
strings.滚轮缩放 · {hint} · 双击编辑文字: Scroll to zoom · {hint} · Double-click to edit text
strings.滚轮缩放 · 拖动平移\n{hint} · 双击编辑文字:
Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan
{hint} · Double-click to edit text
strings.调高会保留更多候选，也会增加误检。: Higher values keep more candidates but also increase false detections.
strings.先放大到感兴趣的区域，减少大片阴影、边框和水印的干扰。: Zoom in to the area of interest first to reduce interference from large shadows, borders and watermarks.
strings.选列表中的编号，或点击照片中的候选坑。当前编号始终显示在底部确认条。: Pick a number in the list, or click a candidate crater in the photo. The current number is always shown in the confirmation bar at the bottom.
strings.点击地名后确认。这里只列环形山；月溪、山脉等在“手动补点”中选择。: Click a name, then confirm. Only craters are listed here; select rilles, mountain ranges and other features under "Add points manually".
strings.查看已确认的参考点并校准: Review confirmed reference points and calibrate
strings.只检测疑似坑中心，地名需人工确认。阴影、山脊可能误检；中心有偏差时可重选。半径以: Detects candidate crater centres only; feature names must be confirmed manually. Shadows and ridges may cause false detections; re-pick the centre if it is off. Radii are measured in original-image pixels.
strings.高程图尚未生成；请先生成或关闭高程着色再导出。: The elevation overlay is not ready. Generate it or turn it off before exporting.
strings.高程图需要 DEM：请导入或下载基础 LOLA 高程数据。: The elevation overlay needs a DEM. Import one or download the basic LOLA data.
strings.高程图未生成，请检查 DEM 后重新生成；已有标注保留。: Elevation overlay failed. Check the DEM and regenerate; existing annotations are preserved.
strings.高程数据没有覆盖当前照片中的月面。: The elevation data does not cover the lunar surface in this photo.
strings.照片内未找到可靠的晨昏交界，未绘制。可选择工程时间的理论线，或关闭晨昏线。: No reliable terminator was found in this photo. Choose the theoretical line from project time, or disable the terminator.
strings.照片内未找到可靠的晨昏交界；请选择工程时间的理论线，或关闭晨昏线再导出。: No reliable terminator was found in this photo. Choose the theoretical line from project time, or disable the terminator before exporting.
strings.配准后可叠加经纬网、高程图与晨昏线。: Register the photo to add a lunar grid, elevation overlay and terminator.
strings.复用已缓存的 LOLA 数据；首次下载约 33 MB。: Reuses cached LOLA data. The first download is about 33 MB.
strings.按照片亮度估计；调高阈值会收窄覆盖，调低会扩大。拖动立即更新，滚轮只滚动面板。: Estimated from photo brightness. A higher threshold reduces coverage; a lower one expands it. Drag to update immediately; the wheel only scrolls the panel.
strings.重新使用照片自动估计的受光阈值。: Restore the light threshold estimated from the photo.
strings.按真实月面高程生成，每五条加粗；细节受 DEM 分辨率限制。: Generated from lunar elevations, with every fifth contour emphasized. Detail depends on DEM resolution.
strings.等高线尚未生成；请先生成或关闭等高线再导出。: Contours are not ready. Generate them or disable contours before exporting.
strings.高程范围过大，无法生成等高线；请检查 DEM 单位是否为 km。: Elevation range is too large for contours. Check that DEM heights are in km.
strings.按住 {key} 拖动照片区域示意图: Hold {key} and drag to move the photo footprint overview
strings.恢复地名、默认位置和可见性，清除手工编辑。: Restore names, default positions and visibility, clearing manual edits.
strings.应用本页的标注与地图设置，保留手工修改的名称和位置。: Apply annotation and map settings on this page, preserving manually edited names and positions.
strings.勾选立即显示；按住 Cmd / Ctrl 拖动图示，位置随工程保存。: Show immediately when checked; hold Cmd / Ctrl to move the locator. Its position is saved with the project.
strings.重排当前标注的位置，保留改名和隐藏状态；其他待修改设置不生效。: Rearrange the current labels, preserving custom names and hidden labels. Other pending settings are not applied.
strings.坑缘轮廓正在生成，请完成后再导出。: Crater outlines are still being generated. Wait for them to finish before exporting.
strings.手绘坑缘需要高程数据：请下载或导入 DEM；当前显示目录参考圈。: Crater contours need elevation data. Download or import a DEM; catalogue reference rings are shown for now.
strings.部分坑缘未能从高程中提取，仍显示目录参考圈。: Some rims could not be resolved in the DEM; those use catalogue reference rings.
strings.椭圆：将坑缘拟合为平滑椭圆。手绘风：按高程数据提取不规则坑缘，首次后台生成并缓存: Ellipse: fit a smooth ellipse to the rim. Hand-drawn: trace the irregular DEM crest in the background and cache it; indicate reference rings when data are insufficient.
